; Layout: 16K PRG bank 0 = sound driver + data, banks 1-5 = data (graphics, maps, text),
; bank 6 = all casino game screens, bank 7 = fixed bank at $C000-$FFFF (kernel, NMI, floor
; walk, text/number printing, sprites, fades). Every 16K bank ends with a copy of the
; $FF80-$FFFF tail (SelectPrgBank, reset stub, vectors) so reset works with any bank mapped.
; Label conventions: Routine_IfCondition marks the target taken when Condition holds
; (e.g. Foo_IfNotAPressed = APressed returned carry clear; Foo_IfHotspotIdIs01 = HotspotId
; equals $01; Foo_IfPokerStageZero = PokerStage was zero). Routine_Loop is the only loop
; of a short routine and Routine_Return its shared RTS; other targets carry names
; describing the code they start (e.g. PayOneCoin_CannotAfford, SpinFourReels_StepReels,
; EvaluateLineTypeB_Pay100 = pay 100 times the coin value).
; Data records named in the phase-1 map (SongData0, ScreenData05, HotspotX, ...) are
; labels at the record, placed with .org so they carry the CPU address of their bank.
; Unreferenced_*/ *_Unref labels mark statically classified code with no known caller.
; Uncertain interpretations are worded tentatively; see commentary/uncertainties.md.
